disclaimer: This account sits outside the primary Override Zone continuity. In the original timeline, the central crisis resolved in a different configuration of survivors, losses, and unanswered questions. Certain events referenced here are left deliberately unexplained; they may be mentioned once or twice and then abandoned. Not every detail should be treated as authoritative. Read this as a partial record, a rumor with structure, or a memory that does not fully agree with the official board.

factions.name: Hart Family
factions.desc: A wealthy, ruthless bloodline that measures love in obedience and treats weakness as a disease. Its members abuse the thirteenth child, Niro, until he destroys them.

factions.name: Yagami
factions.desc: Naobito and Hana's line. Analytical, survival-driven. Kiritaka is the patriarch.

factions.name: Weavers
factions.desc: Thirteen reality-shapers (Selene, Elara, Lucien, Kael, Amara, Viktor, Mei Ling, Isabella, Omar, Asha, Thorn, Freya, Soren).

factions.name: Rankers
factions.desc: Combatants who climb the lists — Asha, Viktor, Kenshi, Freya, Isolde, Reno.

factions.name: Keys
factions.desc: Nemimoth (Key of Hunger), Naobito/Yurei (Key of Duality).

factions.name: Ivory Board
factions.desc: The ruling body that controls lower districts through Mana Collars, surveillance grids, suppression towers, and hard-light lockdowns. It is truly run by the High Queen, with the King as a figurehead.

factions.name: Kurogane
factions.desc: Saya Kurogane and allies.

factions.name: Independent
factions.desc: Rogue actors: Leon, Proxy, Reno, Omar, Soren, Elias Thorn, Sylvara, The Maid.

factions.name: Dark Maiden
factions.desc: Yurei Himura — the entity behind the puzzle that pulled Naobito in.

factions.name: The 12 True Weavers (The Loom)
factions.desc: The Mistress of Threads' direct enforcers and interpreters of the Law of Containment, each representing a fundamental aspect of stitching and balance (Threads, Neutrality, Time, Souls, Chains, Silence, Flames, Sands, Beasts, Flesh, Storms, Shadows, Fate). They monitor cracked vessels and decide containment or destruction.

factions.name: Specialists
factions.desc: Neutralization mages who track and hunt Corruption Mana leaks and cracked vessels. Ranked (e.g., Rank 5), they use silver-white mana and detection Range Crests. Saya Kurogane is one, torn between duty and empathy.

factions.name: Hart Industries
factions.desc: Niro Hart's global empire spanning phones, cars, food, clothing, medical supplies, and mana-tech, controlling roughly 47% of the Asian mana-tech market. It dominates supply chains so deeply that even Naobito's woven jacket bears a HART thread.

factions.name: School Bullies (Kenji, Haruto, Daisuke)
factions.desc: Naobito's long-time school tormentors who beat and humiliated him for years, shaping his loneliness and his fixation on fixing broken things. Three of them are targeted by Yurei's first spells; Takumi dies.

factions.name: The 12 True Weavers
factions.desc: An order of powerful mana Weavers. Lucien Moreau, Weaver of Time, belongs to it and trains Niro in the Override Zone.

factions.name: Elite Councils of the Nine Realms
factions.desc: The collective hosts of the Blood Tournament, offering a single favor from the councils to each bracket winner and treating Symbiote-Host pairs as single entries with a delayed bracket.

factions.name: Eternal Court of Pure Light
factions.desc: Angelic delegates radiating aqua mana; represented by Aetherion, who explains the tournament rules.

factions.name: Abyssal Dominion
factions.desc: Demon lords pulsing with Malevolence, including Lord Varak and Gorzak the Flayer, who seek to test themselves against the Symbiote-Host pair.

factions.name: Verdant Conclave
factions.desc: Green-natured spirit elders and fighters like Lirael Thornvine, emphasizing patience, efficiency, and living mana.

factions.name: Silver Veil Enclave
factions.desc: Neutralization masters in flowing white robes; the Kurogane Clan's broader neutralization tradition belongs here.

factions.name: Fractured Realms Coalition
factions.desc: Outcasts, rogue vessels, and independent powers; home dimension of Sylvara Kane, where reality was torn apart centuries ago.

factions.name: Kurogane Clan
factions.desc: A neutralization bloodline clan whose proud ordinary is silver-white interruption—stopping other people's miracles before they finish becoming dangerous. Runs a compound of drills, boundary stones, elders, and charts; its pride is threatened when Kitsuke awakens Cryokinesis.

factions.name: Veil Wardens (Neutral Enforcers)
factions.desc: Rogue vessels and independent mages operating from a hidden bunker; they monitor the tournament and offer sanctuary to Naobito if he wins.

factions.name: VeilNet (Underground Broadcast Network)
factions.desc: The hidden mana-society television network streaming the Blood Tournament across encrypted channels, hosted by the incubus/succubus anchor.

factions.name: Rival Mega-Corporation (Earth)
factions.desc: A rival Tokyo mega-corp whose CEO watches the feed and plots to kill or recruit Naobito to prevent a Hart alliance.

factions.name: Ivory Board Enforcers
factions.desc: White-and-gold armored units, from street Enforcers to specialist squads with stabilized suppression fields, who police districts and respond to Key signatures.

factions.name: Syndicate Pawns
factions.desc: Collared lower-district residents and laborers packed into bars and streets, watching VeilNet and serving as infrastructure hostages through the collar grid.

factions.name: Yagami Line
factions.desc: The family line behind Haruto and the legendary Naobito. Associated with black coats, telepathy, and stepping into powers older systems preferred caged. Haruto leads the Kurogane compound under the Yagami crest but is not his father.

factions.name: Kashimo Route
factions.desc: Kei and Kenshi Kashimo's fast, unbound network. Reaches places Kurogane banners do not, carries messages and perimeter checks, and treats rules as weather to be moved through rather than obeyed.

factions.name: Crimson Market Network
factions.desc: Neo-Haven's underground market district and its practical contacts (Sae's mute workshop). Sells sealed work, stabilizer lattices, and attention; copper-weave rooms kill telepathy and force ordinary senses.

factions.name: The Board
factions.desc: An old system referenced in upper-realm stories that thought itself permanent until it cracked. Sae's lattice is delivered with no Board tags, marking the Board as a tagging/authority structure from the older era.

concepts.desc: A dimension outside time where clocks stop, mana does not leak, and the Law of Containment does not apply; a void of memory islands where fate can be woven.
Red mana type. Niro's signature. Can be compressed into catastrophic point-force orbs.
Unit of magical energy. Pure-grade seams are high-value currency (48,000 bought Reno's contract).
Folding output back into itself before release to raise density and force; Niro demonstrates 1.7 mega seams uncompressed and 5 compressed.
Naobito Yagami's Key: violet Duality that can rewrite and contain, here used to fight the High Queen while restraining himself.
Nemimoth's Key: a void-touched power that unsettles rooms and pulls at infinity; she is not yet awakened and still requires unlocking.
Multiversal governing body. Uses search-and-destroy pawns; Reno was one until Elara bought his contract.
Multiversal broadcast network. Hosts: Succubus Anchor & Incubus Co-Desk.
Niro's empire: mobility, mana-tech, logistics, consumer fronts. Culturally omnipresent.
Kenshi Kashimo's kinetic technique that pushes his body past Mach 5, leaving trails of blue plasma and burning his reserves hot and fast.
Six layers answered faster than Naobito's nerves in the pit vs Isolde.
A living force that must be locked inside something (soul, bone, coin, blade, cloth) or it rots everything it touches. It is not mist or wind; free mana dissolved cities in the first age.
The rule that mana must be stored, measured, and released only through physical objects or disciplined souls; no free-floating mana. Written in the Mistress's blood after the first age.
The violet, ancient, hungry mana of Yurei Himura, born from betrayal and broken salvation, that feeds on attachment and ownership. Naobito carries tens of thousands of Seams of it.
Niro Hart's deep bloody-red energy that lets him absorb, generate, and convert any energy (physical, thermal, kinetic, mana) at will, measured around 1.7 million Seams.
Silver-white mana used by Specialists like Saya to detect, neutralize, and contain Corruption, often forming clean geometric circles.
The unit of measurement for mana quantity and density (e.g., tens of thousands for Naobito/Yurei, ~1.7 million for Niro).
A geometric mana pattern drawn on the ground or in the air; Naobito creates a unique 'Sixfold Eclipse' six-winged, six-eyed pattern that establishes a controlled field of Corruption Mana.
A technique using obsidian coins as catalysts to stitch space itself, folding locations together in a violent snap; Reno's signature ability.
The cursed puzzle was one of six keys; Naobito realizes he himself is the larger puzzle/key, designed by the Mistress of Threads, with five more keys yet to turn.
A person designed to bond with a fallen entity; Naobito is the first vessel to achieve symbiosis with Yurei instead of being consumed.
Yurei's mark on Naobito: six shadow wings of midnight feathers and torn silk, plus four extra violet eyes on his forehead/temples, giving six total eyes that blink in sync with hers.
The ancient language in which reality was first stitched, readable only by the Mistress by right; Naobito can read it naturally, marking him as something unprecedented.
Endless strips of ancient yellowed cloth stained with blood and sigils that Yurei uses to bind, smother, and attack, crawling up victims' legs or blooming from mouths.
Japanese name for the Dark Maiden; invoked in spells like 'Kuro no tsubasa yo, yami no ito o hiku' that Naobito casts under possession.
The Hart family creed, spoken by Victor and Elias, that justifies abuse and becomes Niro's justification for slaughter.
The lie Elena is forced to tell police, blaming masked intruders for the massacre.
Hart Industries' development of products powered by controlled mana, including autonomous vehicles and Malevolence engines.
The low-reserve, low-output mana ordinary people run on, colloquially 'green stuff' on Earth, contrasted with fighter-tier mana.
A fighter's one signature trick; Kenshi's is kinetic conversion/speed, Naobito's is the Hollow Shell, Asha's is Beast Mana.

Naobito's technique where black bandages and tentacles erupt and rebuild a housed entity's body around his own architecture, letting him wear Yurei as a biological mech suit and read/rewrite her information.
Naobito's ability, first used against Asha's Apex Mantle, to rewrite a housed entity's foundational data (density, mana composition) in real time, even phasing them through attacks.
Sylvara Kane's hidden designation; her sonic Echo ability and broken geometric node mirror Naobito's, making her the counterpart needed to align the remaining Keys.
A new crest born from Naobito and Sylvara's synced bond, combining six wings with echoing sonic spirals and six eyes, launching the Goliath into deep space.
Asha Nkosi's named technique: a colossal wave of pure predatory Beast Mana shaped like countless spectral jaws and claws that floods the entire pit.
Sylvara's awakened power: a raw, apocalyptic sonic scream that warps air, shatters stone, and weaponizes her fear into devastating force.
Selene's official designation for Naobito after the arena's destruction, sealing the footage to prevent mass panic.
A tournament bracket treating bonded vessel-and-entity pairs as a single entry, with a slight delay to observe the field.
Spatial folds used to reach the Crimson Veil Arena and to travel between dimensions; Hana stitches them effortlessly.
Asha Nkosi's green-and-gold predatory mana that hardens into living armor of fang and claw and coalesces into spectral predators.
Blue mana that absorbs and converts kinetic force, used by Kenshi to catch projectiles and fuel Over-Rev.
Leon Cross's Key: a forehead gemstone that drinks ambient energy and fires concentrated cobalt beams of destruction.
Suppression hardware locked around lower-district residents' necks, throttling Key output and feeding a live collar grid.
The High Queen's power, wielded as spears and lashes of condensed absence that shear through Duality.
Loyalty lines threaded through the Dome's guardians, cut by Amara to disable its defenses.
The tower system feeding a live collar pulse into three districts; if collapsed wrong, it cooks linked collars, so the pulse must be disabled first.
Reno's geometric crest that folds space, used to teleport the group from the mag-lev to the warehouse.
Soren's technique of tearing an exit from absolute shadow, starved in the Ivory Dome's bright, clean architecture.
The deep structural pull by which Keys recognize each other, as when Nemimoth senses Sylvara's Echo.
The High Queen's claim that the Keys will stop being sentient and become weapons capable of dismantling or fabricating anything, and that a 'god' made them as jokes.
When Yurei fully surfaces along the bond, six violet eyes burn and her voice layers in perfect terrible unison.
Kurogane silver-white interruption art: stopping other people's miracles before they finish becoming dangerous. The clan's proud ordinary and Kitsuke's expected inheritance.
True-form innate ice weave; Kitsuke's mismatched gift, appearing as frost, ice lines, sheets, and snow flowers. Answers training when not clutched.
Haruto's ability to hear thoughts, sort them (threats, lies, private fears), and apply simple command pressure to a decision-center. Costs more for complex orders and fails more often.
Short, simple telepathic orders such as 'Stop' that turn the surface of a person more easily than deeper thoughts; used by Haruto in the Crimson Market.
Matte-black coin with mana-worked geometric seams that folds space; opens a violet-black sigil transporting users between compound and Neo-Haven. Landing drift can be off by degrees.
Dark metal and cloudy crystal frame from Sae's workshop; seated into boundary stones to keep a junior's surge from ringing public wards. Argues with old stones, then settles.
Warded compound markers scored with neutralization marks over older cuts; conduct mana and hum when the lattice is seated.
Quarterly showing where junior disciples display control, elders watch bloodlines behave, and instructors pretend not to gamble on stagnation.
Compound term for a disciple with no awakened weave; Jin turns the absence into room, footwork, and stubbornness.
Elders' framing for a gift that does not match the family brochure; Saito reframes it as uncomfortable, not cursed.
A tournament spoken of in upper-realm rumor, associated with Naobito Yagami and the breaking of skies and people.
A figure from old stories who collected futures; part of the Naobito legend.
Six (or people-like) entities from old stories, 'not metal' but people or almost people; one is 'a girl who could eat rooms by being lonely too hard.'
An old system that thought itself permanent until it cracked; Sae's lattice has no Board tags.
A referenced designer behind which half the clans may still be walking; Elder Morinaga warns names like Yagami make elders sit up because of what might sit behind them.
A referenced figure in the old-name list (Dome, Queen, Maiden, Key); possibly the Dark Maiden of the wider Override Zone, but this account leaves her deliberately unexplained.
The main continuity this account sits outside of; the Timeline Notice says the central crisis resolved differently there.
Kitsuke's recurring dream of a giant made of cold with a broken shrine-gate head; it laughs at his frost and is checked by winged dark and blue plasma. He turns the fear into training.
A room shielded by copper-weave and old sigils that blocks telepathy in and out, forcing reliance on ordinary senses.

relationships.note: Closest strategic partnership. Plots as systems. Trust high, warmth limited.
Best covert pairing. Silence and shadows. Excellent extractions.
Volatile kinship. Fire and storm escalate and cover blind spots.
Soft-power axis. Souls and terrain. Survival corridors and aftermath care.
Hardline alignment. Containment and hierarchy.
Rival-respect. Measure each other in impact.
Transactional. They use his brilliance; he uses their cover.
High Weaver. Law and final process. Respected more than loved. Isolated by rank.
Vessel and Dark Maiden bound by the puzzle; evolves from toxic possession and ownership into a fragile, chosen partnership where she becomes a voice and he decides when to call on her power.
Empathetic bond between a hunted vessel and a bleeding-heart Specialist; Saya sees his pain and loneliness and chooses to protect and understand him rather than erase him.
Mutual recognition of two people tired of being stepped on; Niro sees Naobito as a fascinating equal or new toy, while Naobito refuses to be anyone's victim and meets his challenge.
Mentor/guide dynamic; Lucien offers the Override Zone and watches Naobito's possible futures without interfering, acting as his closest ally among the Weavers.
Tailor and project; Elara measures and stitches him, wants containment, and dispatches Reno as failsafe, yet is intrigued by his unprecedented symbiosis.
Master and yandere devotee; Mireille kills for him with obsessive love, while Niro treats her as a useful, replaceable tool and keeps her at arm's length.
Novice and master; Kael grants her permission to observe Naobito and warns her about the Dark Maiden, while Saya's emotion challenges his neutrality.
Weaver and pawn; Reno is her body, catalyst-carrier, and hidden failsafe, silent and obedient, though he shows small acknowledgments of Naobito's growth.
Victim and tormentors; years of bullying shaped Naobito's isolation and fueled Yurei's first acts of shadow violence against them.
Oracle and community; she once healed and bound oaths for her village until warlords burned it, breaking her into the Dark Maiden.
Victim and chief bully; Takumi's public humiliation triggers Yurei's lethal retaliation, making him the first major casualty of Naobito's possession.
Abusive father and thirteenth son; Victor's creed and lessons forge Niro's hatred, and Niro kills him during the massacre.
Mother and son bound by her silence; she watches his abuse and survives the massacre, forced to live with the truth.
The only genuine bond Niro has; Thad protects him and is murdered by the other siblings, becoming the catalyst for Niro's slaughter.
Rival siblings; Seraphine is the golden heir who torments Niro and conspires to kill Thad, and Niro obliterates her in the massacre.
Tormentor and victim; Edward's psychological cruelty ends when Niro kills him first in the dining hall.
Brute and target; Nigel's beatings are repaid when a Malevolence orb blows through his chest.
Student and Weaver mentor; Lucien trains Niro in the Override Zone and warns that consequences return.
Opposing siblings; Thad tries to protect Niro while Seraphine mocks him and removes him as a threat.
Patriarch and silent wife; Victor demands obedience and Elena survives by never looking at Niro.
New CEO and resistant director; Niro breaks Cho's will and forces his retirement.
Mother and son: Hana reveals herself as the Mistress and Naobito's mother, triggering his infant memory; she tests and proudly watches him while he refuses to be her puzzle.
Father and son: Kiritaka confirms he knew of the Key design, expresses pride, warns of waking Keys, and teases Yurei before vanishing.
Childhood friends reunited: Kenshi travels across dimensions to back Naobito up, fights beside him to a draw against Asha, and hides with him in Neo-Haven.
Key of Duality and Key of Echoes: bonded through a mindscape meeting and a fused Range Crest, becoming the first two aligned Keys.
Rival respect: Asha fights them at full strength and, after being forced defensive, acknowledges them as worthy opponents worth keeping alive.
Mutual respect: Yurei calls Hana a true weaver who knows what she made, and Hana's test forces Yurei to accept Naobito rewriting her code.
Maiden and echo: Yurei awakens Sylvara's Echo with a single command and calls her 'little echo,' guiding the new Key.
Weaver and pawn: Reno reports Naobito's stabilized stats to Elara, who smiles thinly and treats her pawn as a measuring tool.
Speed vs Beast: Kenshi threads the needle through her Apex Mantle, earning her grudging respect and a kinetic scar she keeps.
Collared Key and half-scavenged cyborg who move through the underbelly together; Proxy hacks and records while Leon provides firepower.
Vampire rescuer and extracted Key; she brokers his survival and he breaks Board symbols for her shadow war.
Mentor and student in mana compression; Niro teaches Leon to fold his cobalt beam into something decisive.
New allies who spar in the sublevel and fight side by side during the suppression-tower attack.
Disowned sisters on opposite sides of the Board; Iris resents being used as Elara's VIP courier.
He calls her brother and stays behind in the Dome to let her escape; she fears for him and refuses to return if he is broken.
Weaver and vessel operating in tandem; Soren extracts Nemimoth on Naobito's order and later watches over her.
Antagonists: she expects and wounds him, he refuses to become her spectacle; she reveals the prophecy of the Keys.
Incomplete Keys who recognize each other; Nemimoth calls Sylvara 'sister' in the safehouse.
Mistress and unawakened Key; Hana reassures Nemimoth and states she still requires unlocking.
Father and daughter; he risks his position to aid her escape and gives Leon the regulator backdoor.
Mother and daughter bound by isolation and control; Nemimoth fears her mother's appetite for breaking things.
Specialist and extracted Key; Saya offers safety and tells her she does not have to earn rest.
Guard and charge; Reno escorts her to the safehouse and seals the wards while she connects with Sylvara.
Best friends; Kenshi fights to reach the news of Naobito's capture and is dragged into the Override Zone with him.
Rival authorities; she accuses him of overstepping as he stops her private duel and relocates the board.
Antagonists: Yurei threatens the High Queen for wounding Naobito, layered sixfold and hostile.
Telepathic mentor and protector: Haruto hears Kitsuke's loud thoughts, trains his ice indirectly, seats the lattice, and keeps clan panic off him; Kitsuke trusts him with wary affection.
Brothers: Ryo is the steady rear guard who insists on being told before Kitsuke leaves the walls and blocks the main path for him.
Siblings: Aya worries fiercely, threatens war over nicknames, and refuses to let Kitsuke be pulled out of his depth quietly.
Siblings: Mei's affection (snow flowers, waves, snowflake delight) makes the compound survivable for Kitsuke.
Mother and son: Hanae chooses arms-first comfort over politics and keeps a light on after the abduction.
Trainee and trainer with a flirtatious edge: Kei teaches 'let it run ahead,' calls him snowflake, and is beaten protecting him.
Sparring partners: Jin offers gimmickless belonging and shows that fights can be fun, not trials.
Rivals turned respectful: Toma underestimates Kitsuke, then bows from one knee and admits it.
Diagnostician and patient: Saito names the cryokinesis clean and sets limits without calling it a curse.
Manipulator and target: the elder offers a 'better place' that reads as a different cage.
Captor and captive: the operative sedates and removes Kitsuke for a master who collects useful winters.
Father and son (referenced): Haruto is not his father, but blood remembers direction; Naobito's legend shapes expectations around Haruto.
Old connection through Naobito: Sae confessed to Naobito; Haruto collects her lattice and lets her old grievance land.
Accepted visitor and host: Haruto grants temporary status, tolerates her testing of doors, and trusts her with ice training.
Mutual respect across systems: Haruto calls Kenshi unconditionally caring, smart, and unbound.
Niece and uncle: Kei carries Kashimo weather and routes; Kenshi's reputation precedes her.
Tense cooperation: Hanae fears Yagami authority but accepts practical protection and lattice prevention.
Co-guardians: siblings coordinate to protect Kitsuke and the family wing.
Host clan and leading line: the compound lives under Yagami leadership after the crest changed weight.
Cautious contact: officers distrust Kei's unauthorized entry while Haruto accepts her routes.

dossiers.title: Ivory Board Brief — Niro Hart
dossiers.summary: Restricted brief. Niro Hart: sole surviving Hart heir, Malevolence (red), mana compression, Hart Industries empire. Born 13th child; slaughtered family at 16; left mother alive as punishment. Boredom is an operational risk.

dossiers.title: VeilNet Live — Reno interview
dossiers.summary: Reno (field asset) bought by Lady Elara from Ivory Board for 48,000 pure-grade seams. Former search-and-destroy pawn. Loyal to clear contract.

dossiers.title: VeilNet Live — Isolde Aster
dossiers.summary: Former Sword Saint of Lightning, returned. Finds Naobito attractive (inherited from Kiritaka). Separates Maiden-speed from Naobito's choices.

dossiers.title: Weavers Dossier
dossiers.summary: Thirteen Weavers with peer assessments and a relationship map: core pairs, trust clusters, factional read of the rebellion era.

locations.name: Naobito's Cramped Bedroom / Empty Apartment
locations.desc: A small, parentless apartment with a single futon, cracked mirror, and silence where Naobito lives alone and solves puzzles. It is where the puzzle is solved, Yurei possesses him, and he scrubs Takumi's blood from his hands.

locations.name: School (Hallway, Cafeteria, Rooftop, Gates)
locations.desc: Naobito's school where bullies torment him and Takumi is killed in a bloody explosion. The hallway becomes a slaughterhouse; the cafeteria is where Reno collects Naobito; the rooftop becomes a training arena in the Zone.

locations.name: Abandoned Rail Yard Lot
locations.desc: A junk collector's trash pile behind an old rail yard where Naobito finds the cursed shifting-rune puzzle. It later appears as a floating memory island in the Override Zone.

locations.name: Lady Elara's Atelier
locations.desc: A Gothic-modern pocket-dimension workshop of black steel beams, smoked glass, crimson velvet, and obsidian mannequins. It enforces the Law of Containment absolutely, muzzling Yurei, and serves as Elara's measuring ground.

locations.name: Override Zone
locations.desc: A timeless violet-black void outside normal time where the Law of Containment does not apply. Memory islands drift like lanterns; it serves as a forge for Naobito's training, negotiation with Yurei, and creation of his Range Crest.

locations.name: Loom Sanctum
locations.desc: A vast circular chamber in a pocket dimension of silver and midnight threads, with twelve obsidian thrones and rotating Range Crest constellations. It is where the 12 True Weavers judge Naobito.

locations.name: Sanctum of Absolute Zero
locations.desc: A hidden, perfectly neutral chamber beneath Mount Fuji of white marble pillars and silver Range Crests where Master Kael Voss resides and Saya reports.

locations.name: Abandoned Subway Platform
locations.desc: A cracked, disused concrete platform deep beneath Tokyo where Saya traces violet residue and first meets Elara and Reno.

locations.name: Late-Night Ramen Shop / Alley
locations.desc: A tiny, warm tonkotsu ramen shop in a narrow alley where Naobito and Saya share a humanizing meal, followed by Niro Hart's dramatic arrival.

locations.name: Hart Spire (Obsidian Penthouse)
locations.desc: Niro Hart's luxurious top-floor penthouse of black marble, blood-red accents, and a grand piano overlooking Tokyo, where he plots and later receives Naobito.

locations.name: Hart Manor
locations.desc: The family estate containing the training hall, portrait room, dining hall, west study, Thad's shrine-room, Niro's small room, and Victor's study.

locations.name: Mountain Village (Yurei's Origin)
locations.desc: The village where every child was taught to weave and where young Yurei Himura served as a living oracle binding wounds and oaths, before warlords burned it.

locations.name: Memory Islands (within Override Zone)
locations.desc: Floating islands inside the Zone displaying looping memories: Naobito's bedroom, the bloody school hallway, the burning village, and the rail-yard puzzle corner.

locations.name: Hart family cemetery
locations.desc: Where Elias Hart is buried and eight-year-old Niro first sparks Malevolence Mana.

locations.name: Training hall beneath the manor
locations.desc: A cold marble chamber lined with mirrors where Niro's 'lessons' are administered.

locations.name: Hart Industries headquarters (47th floor)
locations.desc: The boardroom where Niro confronts and breaks Director Cho.

locations.name: Mountain road
locations.desc: Where Thaddeus Hart is murdered in a staged car accident.

locations.name: Hospital
locations.desc: Where Elena Hart is interviewed by detectives and repeats the home-invasion lie.

locations.name: Crimson Veil Arena
locations.desc: A colossal stadium carved from black stone and living shadow hidden beneath three continents, reachable only through Folded gates. It is destroyed when Naobito, Yurei, and Kenshi's final clash shatters its spatial barriers, leaving an open crater under the sky.

locations.name: Deep Space / Void Observatory
locations.desc: Naobito and Yurei's violet pocket of Corruption Mana where they watch the tournament broadcast, receive Kiritaka's visit, and feel Hana's pull.

locations.name: Ethereal Sanctum
locations.desc: Hana Yagami's dimension of starlight and cosmic silk where she and Kiritaka observe the fight on ethereal screens and discuss the Hollow Shell.

locations.name: Competitor's Lounge
locations.desc: A dim, concrete under-arena room where Naobito crashes after his first fight, tended by Saya and analyzed by Reno.

locations.name: Under-Arena Corridors
locations.desc: Damp tunnels beneath the arena where Naobito, Saya, Sylvara, Reno, and Kenshi regroup between matches.

locations.name: Weavers' VIP Box
locations.desc: A suspended arc of obsidian thrones where the 12 True Weavers watch, calculate, and are shocked by Naobito's power and Lucien's warmth.

locations.name: Niro's Luxury Box
locations.desc: A private box on the opposite side where Niro Hart and Mireille Vale watch with wine and obsessive devotion.

locations.name: Kurogane Estate
locations.desc: A traditional Japanese estate with warded walls where Saya's clan watches the VeilNet feed and plots.

locations.name: Rival Corp Tower (Tokyo)
locations.desc: A sleek high-rise boardroom where a rival mega-corp CEO watches the feed and plots against Naobito.

locations.name: Veil Wardens Bunker
locations.desc: A hidden bunker beneath the city where rogue vessels and independent mages monitor the tournament.

locations.name: Primal Expanse
locations.desc: Asha Nkosi's lush, overgrown jungle domain where she keeps her scars as trophies after the fight.

locations.name: Apex Spire
locations.desc: The grand hall of the True Weavers where Selene designates Naobito a Class-S Reality Anomaly and Viktor forges reality-binding chains.

locations.name: Chrono-Sanctum
locations.desc: Lucien Moreau's timeless room of starlight where he moves chess pieces across a multiversal board, ending on Neo-Haven.

locations.name: Neo-Haven, Nevada
locations.desc: A neon-lit desert city with thin Veil and smuggler Gates; Kenshi's home and later the hiding place of Naobito, Yurei, and Kenshi.

locations.name: The Underbelly Dive Bar
locations.desc: A bar buried under the floating sector of the Ivory Board, wedged between rusted support pillars, where Syndicate Pawns watch illegal VeilNet feeds.

locations.name: Pawn District
locations.desc: The Ivory Board's lower district of wet concrete, neon, and collared residents, sealed into kill-boxes during white lockdowns.

locations.name: Ivory Dome
locations.desc: The High Queen's pristine white chamber of seamless floors and silence wards, designed for isolation and containment, breached by the Weavers' assault.

locations.name: Ivory Board Elite District Overlook
locations.desc: High-altitude terraces and observation spires above the Pawn District, where Soren and Nemimoth watch the damaged Dome.

locations.name: Neo Haven
locations.desc: A rain-soaked Thin Veil city of stacked hab-blocks, mag-lev transit, and black-market junctions, used as a safe staging ground.

locations.name: Neo Haven Mag-Lev Transit
locations.desc: Crowded vertical transit lines where Iris masks Leon's Key signature and Reno folds the group out.

locations.name: Abandoned Warehouse (Neo Haven)
locations.desc: A high-concrete, broken-skylight warehouse where Reno folds the group and removes Leon's collar.

locations.name: Niro Hart's Penthouse (Neo Haven)
locations.desc: A pristine glass-walled penthouse high above the city, serving as neutral ground with beds, privacy wards, and a warded sublevel.

locations.name: Warded Sublevel (Testing Floor)
locations.desc: A black-plated containment floor beneath the penthouse where Leon fires the Key of Focus and Niro teaches compression.

locations.name: Ivory Board Suppression Tower
locations.desc: A Board-affiliated tower anchoring the collar-signal relay for three lower sectors, publicly destroyed by Leon's compressed cobalt beam.

locations.name: The Loom Sanctum
locations.desc: An immense hall of living thread and pale cosmic light where Hana sits on a throne of woven starlight and the Weavers argue over Nemimoth.

locations.name: Override Zone (Obsidian Platform)
locations.desc: A vast violet-black void outside time where Lucien drags the factions to discuss the prophecy.

locations.name: Temporary Domicile (Elara's Safehouse)
locations.desc: A sealed, private, warded apartment arranged by Elara where Nemimoth is housed with Reno, Saya, and Sylvara.

locations.name: Kurogane Compound
locations.desc: Home of the Kurogane clan: pale stone, black banners, practice yards, family wing, archive wing, and boundary stones. Where Kitsuke awakens, trains, and is abducted.

locations.name: Elder Morinaga's House
locations.desc: Smells of old paper and roasted barley tea; where shaped history is poured with tea.

locations.name: Assessment Room (Archive Wing)
locations.desc: Old room with faded wall charms behind the archive wing where Elder Saito measures weaves with a lens.

locations.name: Neo-Haven
locations.desc: American rain-and-neon city reached by obsidian travel coin; contains the Crimson Market District.

locations.name: Crimson Market District
locations.desc: Neo-Haven market of fried oil, wet wiring, red neon, and illegal upper rooms; where Kitsuke learns the city sells everything, including attention.

locations.name: Sae's Mute Workshop
locations.desc: Copper-weave dampened room in the Crimson Market where telepathy cannot enter or leave; lit by ordinary lamps, full of tools and sealed work.

locations.name: Outer Path / North Gate
locations.desc: Packed dirt beyond the compound's north gate where banners stop; meeting place for Kei Kashimo.

locations.name: West Boundary Stones
locations.desc: Mossy old markers scored with Kurogane neutralization marks over older cuts; where Haruto seats the stabilizer lattice.

locations.name: North Storehouse Roof
locations.desc: Warm roof where Aya, Mei, and Kitsuke trespass and watch the compound; later Jin and Kitsuke watch sunrise.

locations.name: East Records Annex
locations.desc: Where the suspicious elder and sealed-case courier speak too closely and approach Kitsuke.

locations.name: Central Courtyard
locations.desc: Most visible place in the compound; where Kitsuke and Haruto land from Neo-Haven and where the abduction occurs.

locations.name: Family Wing
locations.desc: Kurogane family rooms: kitchen table, futons, heater; the one place that still feels like theirs.

locations.name: Upper Realms (rumored)
locations.desc: Rumored higher sphere of tournaments, queens, and Keys; source of stories that make servants lower their voices.

events.title: Solving the Cursed Puzzle
events.summary: Naobito fits the final shifting rune in his bedroom; reality snaps to black and Yurei Himura pulls him into the void, binding him with shadow lashes and infinite bandages.

events.title: First Possession and Bully Attack
events.summary: Yurei marks Naobito with six wings and extra eyes, then forces a spell from his lips that makes three bullies collapse with invisible black bandages.

events.title: Takumi Sato's Death
events.summary: Takumi mocks and shoves Naobito in the hallway; Yurei torments him with infinite imaginary pain before his body combusts from the inside out, spraying blood across the corridor.

events.title: Love and Ownership Conversation
events.summary: Naobito demands to know if Yurei loves him; she answers that she loves him as a goddess loves her favorite doll, by ownership, and threatens to make another boy explode.

events.title: Elara's Collection and Atelier Interrogation
events.summary: Reno folds Naobito from the cafeteria to Elara's atelier with an obsidian coin; Elara enforces the Law of Containment, muzzling Yurei, and questions Naobito about the puzzle's origin and intent.

events.title: Three Choices
events.summary: Elara offers containment training, full separation, or refusal (leading to Specialists); Naobito rejects all and demands agency.

events.title: Lucien's Arrival and Override Zone Offer
events.summary: Lucien Moreau appears, revealing Naobito will not die as Yurei's vessel but evolve beyond gods, and offers the time-paused Override Zone as a place to grow without pressure.

events.title: Entry into the Override Zone
events.summary: Naobito chooses the Zone; Yurei floods back into him with wings and eyes; he and Lucien arrive in the violet void with memory islands.

events.title: Toxic Confrontation and Negotiation
events.summary: Naobito calls the bond toxic and demands choice; Yurei argues she was his only protector; he asks her to be a voice, not a possessor. She withdraws extra eyes and wings, becoming a whisper in his mind.

events.title: Combat Training and Range Crest Creation
events.summary: In the Zone, Naobito fights shadow bullies bare-handed, then creates his own 'Sixfold Eclipse' Range Crest, learning to weave Corruption Mana with intent rather than leaking it.

events.title: Saya's Investigation
events.summary: Saya traces violet residue at the school and an abandoned subway platform, feeling Naobito's loneliness, and vows to give him a chance before erasure.

events.title: Kael's Briefing
events.summary: Saya reports to Master Kael Voss in the Sanctum of Absolute Zero; he permits observation and warns that the Dark Maiden will burn the world to keep Naobito.

events.title: Return to Real World and Meeting Saya
events.summary: Naobito exits the Zone to a Tokyo rooftop and meets Saya, who shares her past and the 12 Weavers' stances over a late-night ramen meal.

events.title: Niro Hart's Introduction
events.summary: Niro arrives in a limousine after the ramen dinner, introduces himself as a bored quintillionaire killer, and offers Naobito partnership; he later details his family massacre.

events.title: Loom Sanctum Trial
events.summary: The 12 True Weavers gather to judge Naobito; he demands proper introductions, reads the Mistress's geometric script on Selene's shoulder, and reveals the puzzle's deeper purpose.

events.title: Six Keys Revelation
events.summary: Naobito declares the six-winged puzzle was one of six keys and that he himself is the puzzle designed by the Mistress of Threads, making him unsealable and potentially the next evolution of the Law.

events.title: Departure to Niro Hart
events.summary: Naobito abruptly asks Reno to take him to Niro Hart, bypassing the council; Reno folds him to Hart Spire's penthouse balcony, where Niro welcomes him.

events.title: Funeral of Elias Hart
events.summary: At eight years old, Niro attends his grandfather's funeral, hears Victor's creed that weakness is a disease, and ignites the first spark of Malevolence Mana.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: The Lessons (ages 8-12)
events.summary: Victor and four siblings subject Niro to physical, psychological, and verbal abuse in the training hall, forging his hatred and resolve.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Mother's Choice
events.summary: Elena watches Niro's abuse from behind one-way glass and chooses silence and survival over protecting him.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Accidental Entry into the Override Zone
events.summary: Fourteen-year-old Niro, beaten and angry, tears a hole into the Override Zone and meets Lucien Moreau, who allows him to train there.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Override Zone Training: How to Hold Hate
events.summary: Lucien teaches Niro to compress his screaming Malevolence Mana into dense, controlled orbs, marking his first real step toward power.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Thad's Plea to Victor
events.summary: Thad asks Victor to stop Niro's lessons and offers to surrender his inheritance; Victor refuses and Seraphine mocks him.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Murder of Thaddeus Hart
events.summary: Seraphine, Edward, and Nigel stage Thad's death as a car accident on the mountain road to remove his protection of Niro.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Discovery of the Murder Plot
events.summary: On the eve of his sixteenth birthday, Niro overhears Seraphine, Edward, and Nigel confessing that they killed Thad, snapping his last mercy.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Hart Family Massacre
events.summary: Sixteen-year-old Niro slaughters his father and ten siblings with Malevolence Mana during a family dinner, sparing only his mother.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: The Quiet After Blood
events.summary: After the massacre, Niro visits Thad's shrine-room, changes into a clean identical outfit, and steels himself before seizing the empire.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Cover-Up and Inheritance
events.summary: Niro coerces Elena into telling police a home-invasion story, transfers ownership of Hart Industries, and inherits everything at sixteen.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Police Interview
events.summary: Elena repeats the home-invasion lie to detectives while Niro watches through the glass with his demonic smile.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Hiring of Mireille Vale
events.summary: At nineteen, Niro hires Mireille as his secretary after she declares her obsessive devotion to his ego and elegance.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: First Boardroom Kill
events.summary: Niro exposes Director Cho's crimes and has Mireille break his wrist and threaten him, forcing Cho's retirement and securing the board.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Empire Building and Boredom
events.summary: From nineteen to twenty-seven, Niro expands Hart Industries, kills when necessary, and grows bored as a quintillionaire.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Rumor of the Tokyo Vessel
events.summary: At twenty-seven, Niro hears of a boy in Tokyo bonded to an ancient maiden and leaking Corruption Mana, sparking his interest.
events.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat

events.title: Blood Tournament Opening
events.summary: The Crimson Veil Arena opens with thousands of spectators; the 12 True Weavers, Niro Hart, and representatives of the Nine Realms are introduced before the first bouts.

events.title: Naobito's Meteor Arrival
events.summary: Naobito and Yurei shatter their viewing window and descend from deep space as a blazing violet meteor, cracking the arena floor and announcing the Symbiote-Host bracket.

events.title: Hana Yagami's Arrival
events.summary: The Mistress of Threads steps into the pit in cyan mana, freezing the arena, and triggers a memory flashback of Naobito's infancy as the first Key.

events.title: Naobito vs Lord Varak
events.summary: Lord Varak shatters Hana's gate to challenge Naobito, but is systematically dismantled and bound in violet bandages within seconds.
participants: Lord Varak of the Red Abyss

events.title: Isolde Aster's Challenge
events.summary: The revived Sword Saint of Lightning fights Naobito in a cyan-violet storm dome, delivers Hana's message that the tournament is a filter and the Keys are hidden among the fighters, and whispers 'Pass' upon defeat.

events.title: Hollow Shell Split & Mindscape Bridging
events.summary: Yurei is pulled into Naobito's mindscape (a rainy apartment) to bridge broken soul-nodes while Naobito fights Isolde solo, then returns with administrative access and optimized power.

events.title: Sylvara's Awakening
events.summary: Yurei's voice tells Sylvara to scream; her Echo ability awakens in an apocalyptic sonic blast that staggers the Goliath.

events.title: Fused Range Crest vs Goliath
events.summary: Naobito and Sylvara create a fused Range Crest and launch the Goliath several light-years into deep space.

events.title: Mindscape Bonding
events.summary: Naobito pulls Sylvara into his mindscape, where she feels like family; they agree to finish the fight together.

events.title: Kenshi's Arrival
events.summary: Kenshi Kashimo travels from Neo-Haven via smuggler Gate, breaks into the under-arena corridor, and reunites with Naobito.

events.title: Asha Nkosi's Challenge
events.summary: Asha invokes her authority as a True Weaver to turn her match into a 2v1 against Naobito/Yurei and Kenshi, demanding a full-strength fight.

events.title: Hollow Shell vs Asha
events.summary: Naobito uses K'tai to house Yurei in a reconstructed body, fighting Asha with scythe, wings, and Kenshi's kinetic support, then rewriting Yurei's code to phase through Apex Mantle.

events.title: Arena Destruction
events.summary: The final three-way clash shatters the Crimson Veil Arena's spatial barriers, vaporizing spectator rows and exposing the fight to the open sky.

events.title: Draw Declaration & Class-S Designation
events.summary: Selene declares the match a draw and designates Naobito a Class-S Reality Anomaly, sealing the footage.

events.title: Finals Announcement
events.summary: Hana declares Naobito already qualified for the finals and places him directly into the Weavers' VIP box, where Lucien shows unprecedented warmth.

events.title: Kiritaka's Visit
events.summary: Naobito's immortal father appears in deep space, confirms his knowledge of the Key design, expresses pride, and warns that the remaining Keys are waking.

events.title: Epilogues
events.summary: Asha keeps her scars in the Primal Expanse; Selene designates Naobito Class-S and Viktor forges reality-binding chains while Thorn drafts a chimera; Lucien moves three pieces onto a Neo-Haven square.

events.title: Blood Tournament Aftermath Broadcast
events.summary: VeilNet Live in Lusthara interviews Kenshi and Naobito about the arena's collapse and the anomalous rewrite event while millions watch.

events.title: Leon Cross's Bar Confrontation and White Lockdown
events.summary: An Ivory Board Knight demands Leon's bar and power grid after an unregistered Key signature; Leon's collar flares; Iris Vane tears a blood rift and extracts Leon and Proxy.

events.title: Extraction to Neo Haven and Iris's Deal
events.summary: Iris brings Leon and Proxy to Neo Haven and offers protection and collar removal in exchange for breaking Board assets.

events.title: Reno's Fold and Shadow-War Revelation
events.summary: Reno folds the group into a warehouse, reveals the Weavers are building a rebellion against the High Queen, and removes Leon's collar, awakening the Key of Focus.

events.title: Niro's Penthouse and Neutral-Ground Arrangement
events.summary: The group arrives at Niro's penthouse; Niro offers shelter and a front-row seat to Board damage while Mireille distrusts Leon.

events.title: Kenshi's Arrival and Sparring
events.summary: Kenshi arrives at the penthouse, spars with Leon in the sublevel, and the group plans a public strike on a Board suppression tower.

events.title: Leon's Sublevel Training and Compression Lesson
events.summary: Leon fires the Key of Focus in the warded sublevel; feeling it is only a laser, he receives Niro's mana-compression lesson and demonstration of 5 mega seams.

events.title: Naobito's Sealed Meeting with Six Weavers
events.summary: Naobito asks Amara, Mei Ling, Isabella, Omar, Freya, and Soren to help extract Nemimoth from the Ivory Dome; they agree to a preliminary assessment.

events.title: Yurei's Warning in the Mindscape
events.summary: Yurei confronts Naobito about moving too fast and risking both of them for Nemimoth; he embraces her and reaffirms he is not replacing her.

events.title: Shadow-Breach of the Ivory Dome
events.summary: Soren pulls Naobito into Nemimoth's chamber; Nemimoth greets him as brother; the High Queen enters expecting him; Naobito orders Soren to take Nemimoth and stays behind.

events.title: Elite District Overlook Watch
events.summary: Soren and Nemimoth watch the damaged Ivory Dome from the elite district terrace; Nemimoth vows not to return if Naobito is broken.

events.title: Naobito vs High Queen
events.summary: Naobito fights the High Queen while restraining himself; she wounds him; Yurei surfaces with six eyes and threatens her; the six Weavers assault the Dome; Lucien stops time.

events.title: High Queen's Prophecy
events.summary: The High Queen tells Naobito the Keys will become sentient weapons and 'god's funniest jokes'; Lucien drags all into the Override Zone to discuss it.

events.title: Kenshi's Warning Call
events.summary: In Niro's sublevel, Kenshi receives a call that Naobito is locked in the Ivory Dome with the High Queen; the group reacts and prepares.

events.title: Leon's Public Destruction of Suppression Tower
events.summary: Leon fires a compressed cobalt beam through the Board suppression tower; Kenshi handles Enforcers; Proxy hijacks feeds; the King provides the regulator backdoor; the pulse dies and collars fail safe; Leon finishes the tower.

events.title: Nemimoth's Extraction to the Loom Sanctum
events.summary: Nemimoth appears in the Loom Sanctum where Hana tells her she is not yet an awakened Key; the Weavers argue over Lucien's overreach.

events.title: Nemimoth's Safehouse and Sister Recognition
events.summary: Reno, Saya, and Sylvara receive Nemimoth in Elara's temporary domicile; Nemimoth senses Sylvara's half-awakened Key of Echoes and calls her sister.

events.title: Timeline Notice
events.summary: The account opens by stating it sits outside primary Override Zone continuity; certain referenced events are deliberately left unexplained and not every detail is authoritative.

events.title: Overheard Names in the Linen Room
events.summary: Kitsuke overhears two maids whispering about Naobito Yagami, the Dome, the Queen, the Keys, and the Mistress, seeding the compound's hidden history.

events.title: Telepathy Confrontation
events.summary: Haruto tells Kitsuke his thoughts are loud, admits he hears and sorts minds, and promises not to report private thoughts; Kitsuke's fear becomes wary trust.

events.title: Family Dinner Disclosure
events.summary: Kitsuke tells his family about Haruto's telepathy; Ryo, Aya, Mei, and Hanae react with anger, worry, and practical protection.

events.title: Crimson Market Errand
events.summary: Haruto takes Kitsuke to Neo-Haven's Crimson Market by obsidian coin, commands a lure to stop, and collects a cleaned stabilizer lattice from Sae in a mute workshop.

events.title: Public Cryokinesis Awakening
events.summary: During demonstration season, Kitsuke's palm on the test crystal produces frost and ice instead of neutralization, shocking the clan; Haruto shields him from gossip.

events.title: Saito's Assessment
events.summary: Elder Saito measures Kitsuke's palm and names the power true-form Cryokinesis, writes limits, and warns that the compound's pride may be harder to train than the ice.

events.title: Kei Kashimo Arrives
events.summary: Kei meets Kitsuke on the outer path, demonstrates speed, gives advice to let ice run ahead, and flirts with the nickname snowflake.

events.title: Kei's Unauthorized Entry
events.summary: Kei enters the compound through rear stones without escort; Haruto grants temporary visitor status under Mother's conditions.

events.title: Lattice Seating at West Boundary
events.summary: Haruto seats the stabilizer lattice into the west boundary stones; the hum steadies the line and Kitsuke learns not to answer the surge with a wall.

events.title: Storehouse Roof Trespass
events.summary: Aya, Mei, and Kitsuke climb the north storehouse roof; Haruto overrides a courier's alarm and lets the children be children.

events.title: Toma Dominance Bout
events.summary: Kitsuke sends ice ahead and puts the older neutralization elite Toma on one knee in the center square, earning respect.

events.title: Jin's Sealed Exchange
events.summary: Gimmickless Jin Kurogane challenges and defeats Kitsuke in pure hand-to-hand, teaching him that fights can be fun and that not all allies light up.

events.title: First Ice Training
events.summary: Kei trains Kitsuke at the west edge to throw frost lines with intention; he converts a panic surge into a controlled sheet.

events.title: Dream of the Ice Giant
events.summary: Kitsuke dreams of a jointed ice giant checked by a winged dark figure and a blue-plasma grinner, then trains before dawn to turn the fear into aimed cuts.

events.title: Snow Flower for Mei
events.summary: After the assessment, Kitsuke makes a small ice flower on the engawa; Mei licks it and laughs, and the family holds together.

events.title: Suspicious Elder's Offer
events.summary: Near the east records annex, a kindly elder warns Kitsuke that some clan attention is inventory and offers a 'better place,' sounding like a different cage.

events.title: Abduction of Kitsuke
events.summary: An unknown matte-black operative defeats Kei, sedates Kitsuke, and carries him out; Haruto arrives too late. Kitsuke is held for a master who collects useful winters.

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: Heeheehee… clever little lamb… you opened my box~

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: Shhh… no more running from bullies, little Naobito. No more hiding. You're mine now. My pretty new toy… my six-winged pet~

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: What… what have I become?

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: I love you the way a goddess loves her favorite doll… the way a storm loves the ship it sinks. I would tear the world apart before I let anyone else touch this body again.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: That's not… that's not love. That's ownership.

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: Ownership is the deepest love I know, sweet Naobito.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: He shouldn't have touched what's mine.

quotes.speaker: Reno
quotes.quote: You're the one leaking.

quotes.speaker: Lady Elara Vane
quotes.quote: You are a cracked vessel, Naobito Yagami. If you do not learn to contain what lives inside you… properly, deliberately, like a craftsman… the pressure will keep building.

quotes.speaker: Lucien Moreau
quotes.quote: This kid will not die as Yami no Otome's vessel. He will evolve beyond even the wildest fantasies of those fraud self-proclaimed gods.

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: We don't need the Weavers, little lamb… They want to contain us. I want to own you the way you already own me—completely.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: I want us to be… something that doesn't destroy me. I want to choose when you speak. I want to choose when the wings come out.

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: Fine, my sweet, stubborn lamb… I'll stay right here… inside your mind. No extra eyes watching you. No wings smothering you. Just me. A voice.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: Skepticism without action is just another cage. Real progress… you have to punch the cage until it breaks.

quotes.speaker: Saya Kurogane
quotes.quote: I stand with the boy who was drowning… and the girl who chose to drown with him rather than let him die alone.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: I like killing, Naobito. Not because I'm broken. But because the world finally learned it was better to kneel than to humiliate me.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: The six-winged puzzle I solved… it wasn't just a prison for Yurei. It was one key. Out of six. And the bigger puzzle… is me.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: I'm done being the boy everyone ignores.

quotes.speaker: Reno
quotes.quote: Time's up.

quotes.speaker: Victor Hart
quotes.quote: My father taught us one thing above all else: weakness is a disease. The Hart name does not tolerate it. We cut it out. We burn it away. Strength is the only currency that matters in this world.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: If weakness is a disease... then I will become the cure. I will cut every single one of you out. One day.

quotes.speaker: Seraphine Hart
quotes.quote: Say it, little brother. 'I am the thirteenth mistake. I will never inherit. I exist only because Mother failed to prevent me.'

quotes.speaker: Thaddeus Hart
quotes.quote: You're not alone, okay? I've got your back. We'll get through this family together.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: Don't promise things this family won't let you keep.

quotes.speaker: Elena Hart
quotes.quote: Forgive me. I thought if I didn't look, they'd forget you. I didn't know they'd try to erase you.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: Good. Then it's mine now.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: I was thinking about how I'm going to kill every single one of them. Slowly.

quotes.speaker: Lucien Moreau
quotes.quote: Time may not move here, but consequences always find their way back.

quotes.speaker: Lucien Moreau
quotes.quote: Hate is heavy - make it dense.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: Did you see that? Three seconds.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: You watched, Mother. Every lesson. Every bruise. Every time they called me the mistake. You never said a word. So I'll let you live with it.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: You always said weakness is a disease, Father. I finally agree. I'm curing it tonight.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: Weakness is a disease. I cut it out.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: Live with it, Mother. That's my punishment.

quotes.speaker: Mireille Vale
quotes.quote: I like your personality, Mr. Hart. Your unmatched ego. Your cold elegance. The way you look at people like they're already dead and just don't know it.

quotes.speaker: Mireille Vale
quotes.quote: Only for you.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: You're insane.

quotes.speaker: Mireille Vale
quotes.quote: Mr. Hart doesn't like no-confidence votes during rain. He finds them... noisy.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: Finally... something interesting.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: Our turn.

quotes.speaker: Hana Yagami
quotes.quote: Let the real game begin.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: I don't care if you're my mother, Mistress.

quotes.speaker: Hana Yagami
quotes.quote: You will address me as 'Ka-san' if speaking directly to me. And if you cannot respect me as a mother... respect me as an elder.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: Your power is loud. But it's empty.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: Tell her... I'm not her puzzle anymore. I'm the one who solves it.

quotes.speaker: Isolde Aster
quotes.quote: Pass.

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: System online, little lamb. Give her hell.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: I'm not waiting for the finals.

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: Breathe, little echo. We've got you.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: Stay behind me. We'll finish this together.

quotes.speaker: Kenshi Kashimo
quotes.quote: My best friend's got a date with a goddess. I'm just the plus-one.

quotes.speaker: Asha Nkosi
quotes.quote: Come, little vessel. Come, loud Earth boy. Show me everything you have.

quotes.speaker: Asha Nkosi
quotes.quote: YES! BREAK IT ALL! LET'S SEE WHO SURVIVES THE FALL!

quotes.speaker: Asha Nkosi
quotes.quote: Well fought... both of you.

quotes.speaker: Lucien Moreau
quotes.quote: Tell me... how many of you still believe the boy is merely a fragile host being controlled by his Dark Maiden?

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: I was expecting to get executed, not adopted.

quotes.speaker: Kenshi Kashimo
quotes.quote: Your mom's a goddess, your dad's immortal, and now the Beast Weaver wants to throw hands for fun. Your life is insane, Nao.

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: She's testing us... separately.

quotes.speaker: Lucien Moreau
quotes.quote: Your move, little anomaly.

quotes.speaker: Hana Yagami
quotes.quote: Prove to them why I chose you.

quotes.speaker: Leon Cross
quotes.quote: So this is what it actually feels like.

quotes.speaker: Iris Vane
quotes.quote: Welcome to the board, Key of Focus.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: I wouldn't dream of it.

quotes.speaker: Kenshi Kashimo
quotes.quote: Morning, sunshine.

quotes.speaker: Mireille Vale
quotes.quote: Do not address Master that way.

quotes.speaker: Kenshi Kashimo
quotes.quote: Easy, Silver. If I wanted trouble, you'd already know.

quotes.speaker: Iris Vane
quotes.quote: So we don't start with sabotage. We start with embarrassment.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: I want to extract Nemimoth from the Ivory Board.

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: You are moving too fast.

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: I did not bind myself to you so you could throw both of us into a void for a girl who called you brother once.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: But I am not reaching for her instead of you. I am not replacing anything.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: You're thinking about it the wrong way.

quotes.speaker: Leon Cross
quotes.quote: No complex weave. No domain. No transformation. Just point and fire.

quotes.speaker: Niro Hart
quotes.quote: You asked if a forehead laser was enough. It is - if you stop treating it like leftover scraps from a collared life and start treating it like the only honest thing they never managed to take from you.

quotes.speaker: High Queen
quotes.quote: I have been expecting you.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: You wanted me here. You have me. Stop circling.

quotes.speaker: High Queen
quotes.quote: A rebellion that grows in the dark is useful, Naobito Yagami. It gathers the strong. And when it is ripe... it becomes a single target.

quotes.speaker: Naobito Yagami
quotes.quote: Your version of honest is just appetite with better posture.

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: You made a mistake.

quotes.speaker: Yurei Himura
quotes.quote: He was restraining himself for reasons that do not include you. Touch what is mine again... and I will stop letting him be polite.

quotes.speaker: High Queen
quotes.quote: You are a Key of Infinity. There will be a time when you will stop being sentient... You are his funniest jokes, Yagami.

quotes.speaker: Lucien Moreau
quotes.quote: Enough.

quotes.speaker: The King
quotes.quote: Because my daughter is no longer inside the cage they built for her. And because I am tired of systems that only know how to survive by attaching themselves to living people.

quotes.speaker: Saya Kurogane
quotes.quote: You don't have to earn the right to sit down. Just sit.

quotes.speaker: Nemimoth
quotes.quote: Sister.

quotes.speaker: Haruto Yagami
quotes.quote: Your thoughts are very loud today, Kitsuke.

quotes.speaker: Haruto Yagami
quotes.quote: I hear more than people want. I do not report every private thought. If I did, this clan would tear itself apart before the week ended.

quotes.speaker: Haruto Yagami
quotes.quote: You are twelve. Your secrets are still small. That is not an insult.

quotes.speaker: Haruto Yagami
quotes.quote: When your thoughts start circling like that again, you may come ask me yourself. It is less exhausting than listening to you invent my crimes in advance.

quotes.speaker: Haruto Yagami
quotes.quote: You did not do wrong by awakening. You only did it publicly. That is inconvenient. Not shameful.

quotes.speaker: Haruto Yagami
quotes.quote: Hiding turns ability into shame, and shame leaks.

quotes.speaker: Haruto Yagami
quotes.quote: If she calls you snowflake in the yard, your sister will declare war. Try not to enjoy that too visibly.

quotes.speaker: Elder Morinaga
quotes.quote: As safe as any house living near old fire.

quotes.speaker: Elder Morinaga
quotes.quote: If you hear more names—Dome, Queen, Maiden, Key—do not swallow them whole. Bring them to someone living. Stories become cruel when children have to carry them alone.

quotes.speaker: Elder Saito
quotes.quote: You are not cursed. You are mismatched to the family brochure. That is uncomfortable. It is not the end of your name.

quotes.speaker: Elder Saito
quotes.quote: He is unbound. That is rarer than malice and harder to chart.

quotes.speaker: Kei Kashimo
quotes.quote: Cold isn't a wall, Kitsuke. Cold is momentum that froze mid-stride. If you wait until you're cornered to use it, you'll just freeze your own feet to the dirt.

quotes.speaker: Kei Kashimo
quotes.quote: If you ever do let that ice run ahead of you… make sure I'm there to see it. I like being first in line when cute boys become problems.

quotes.speaker: Kei Kashimo
quotes.quote: Morning, snowflake. Your house is lively.

quotes.speaker: Kei Kashimo
quotes.quote: Hand-to-hand keeps you human. Ice keeps you alive. Use both or you're only half a problem, and half-problems get filed.

quotes.speaker: Kei Kashimo
quotes.quote: Relax, snowflake. If I was here to cause a problem, I wouldn't start with the cutest one on the path.

quotes.speaker: Jin Kurogane
quotes.quote: The clan's not only the ones who light up. Some of us are on your side the boring way. Remember the fun when the other kind of fight comes back.

quotes.speaker: Sae
quotes.quote: Don't turn into a man who only answers soft things with silence. It's harder on everybody else than he ever understood.

quotes.speaker: Suspicious Elder
quotes.quote: Whenever you feel like they will be done with you, tell me. I will take you to a place better than this compound.

quotes.speaker: The Abductor
quotes.quote: My master is gonna love you.

quotes.speaker: Mei Kurogane
quotes.quote: If he can hear thinking, can we think nice things at him on purpose? Like, good luck? Or stop looking so sad?

quotes.speaker: Hanae Kurogane
quotes.quote: You may tell me the rest tomorrow. Tonight you are here. That is enough.

quotes.speaker: Kitsuke Kurogane
quotes.quote: If that thing is mine, I'm not waiting for anyone next time.

quotes.speaker: Haruto Yagami
quotes.quote: Your aim is improving.

quotes.speaker: Haruto Yagami
quotes.quote: Thank you for the thought. It was quieter than most.

timeline.title: Solving the Cursed Puzzle
timeline.summary: Naobito fits the final shifting rune in his bedroom; reality snaps to black and Yurei Himura pulls him into the void, binding him with shadow lashes and infinite bandages.

timeline.title: First Possession and Bully Attack
timeline.summary: Yurei marks Naobito with six wings and extra eyes, then forces a spell from his lips that makes three bullies collapse with invisible black bandages.

timeline.title: Takumi Sato's Death
timeline.summary: Takumi mocks and shoves Naobito in the hallway; Yurei torments him with infinite imaginary pain before his body combusts from the inside out, spraying blood across the corridor.

timeline.title: Love and Ownership Conversation
timeline.summary: Naobito demands to know if Yurei loves him; she answers that she loves him as a goddess loves her favorite doll, by ownership, and threatens to make another boy explode.

timeline.title: Elara's Collection and Atelier Interrogation
timeline.summary: Reno folds Naobito from the cafeteria to Elara's atelier with an obsidian coin; Elara enforces the Law of Containment, muzzling Yurei, and questions Naobito about the puzzle's origin and intent.

timeline.title: Three Choices
timeline.summary: Elara offers containment training, full separation, or refusal (leading to Specialists); Naobito rejects all and demands agency.

timeline.title: Lucien's Arrival and Override Zone Offer
timeline.summary: Lucien Moreau appears, revealing Naobito will not die as Yurei's vessel but evolve beyond gods, and offers the time-paused Override Zone as a place to grow without pressure.

timeline.title: Entry into the Override Zone
timeline.summary: Naobito chooses the Zone; Yurei floods back into him with wings and eyes; he and Lucien arrive in the violet void with memory islands.

timeline.title: Toxic Confrontation and Negotiation
timeline.summary: Naobito calls the bond toxic and demands choice; Yurei argues she was his only protector; he asks her to be a voice, not a possessor. She withdraws extra eyes and wings, becoming a whisper in his mind.

timeline.title: Combat Training and Range Crest Creation
timeline.summary: In the Zone, Naobito fights shadow bullies bare-handed, then creates his own 'Sixfold Eclipse' Range Crest, learning to weave Corruption Mana with intent rather than leaking it.

timeline.title: Saya's Investigation
timeline.summary: Saya traces violet residue at the school and an abandoned subway platform, feeling Naobito's loneliness, and vows to give him a chance before erasure.

timeline.title: Kael's Briefing
timeline.summary: Saya reports to Master Kael Voss in the Sanctum of Absolute Zero; he permits observation and warns that the Dark Maiden will burn the world to keep Naobito.

timeline.title: Return to Real World and Meeting Saya
timeline.summary: Naobito exits the Zone to a Tokyo rooftop and meets Saya, who shares her past and the 12 Weavers' stances over a late-night ramen meal.

timeline.title: Niro Hart's Introduction
timeline.summary: Niro arrives in a limousine after the ramen dinner, introduces himself as a bored quintillionaire killer, and offers Naobito partnership; he later details his family massacre.

timeline.title: Loom Sanctum Trial
timeline.summary: The 12 True Weavers gather to judge Naobito; he demands proper introductions, reads the Mistress's geometric script on Selene's shoulder, and reveals the puzzle's deeper purpose.

timeline.title: Six Keys Revelation
timeline.summary: Naobito declares the six-winged puzzle was one of six keys and that he himself is the puzzle designed by the Mistress of Threads, making him unsealable and potentially the next evolution of the Law.

timeline.title: Departure to Niro Hart
timeline.summary: Naobito abruptly asks Reno to take him to Niro Hart, bypassing the council; Reno folds him to Hart Spire's penthouse balcony, where Niro welcomes him.

timeline.title: Funeral of Elias Hart
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: At eight years old, Niro attends his grandfather's funeral, hears Victor's creed that weakness is a disease, and ignites the first spark of Malevolence Mana.

timeline.title: The Lessons (ages 8-12)
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: Victor and four siblings subject Niro to physical, psychological, and verbal abuse in the training hall, forging his hatred and resolve.

timeline.title: Mother's Choice
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: Elena watches Niro's abuse from behind one-way glass and chooses silence and survival over protecting him.

timeline.title: Accidental Entry into the Override Zone
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: Fourteen-year-old Niro, beaten and angry, tears a hole into the Override Zone and meets Lucien Moreau, who allows him to train there.

timeline.title: Override Zone Training: How to Hold Hate
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: Lucien teaches Niro to compress his screaming Malevolence Mana into dense, controlled orbs, marking his first real step toward power.

timeline.title: Thad's Plea to Victor
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: Thad asks Victor to stop Niro's lessons and offers to surrender his inheritance; Victor refuses and Seraphine mocks him.

timeline.title: Murder of Thaddeus Hart
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: Seraphine, Edward, and Nigel stage Thad's death as a car accident on the mountain road to remove his protection of Niro.

timeline.title: Discovery of the Murder Plot
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: On the eve of his sixteenth birthday, Niro overhears Seraphine, Edward, and Nigel confessing that they killed Thad, snapping his last mercy.

timeline.title: Hart Family Massacre
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: Sixteen-year-old Niro slaughters his father and ten siblings with Malevolence Mana during a family dinner, sparing only his mother.

timeline.title: The Quiet After Blood
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: After the massacre, Niro visits Thad's shrine-room, changes into a clean identical outfit, and steels himself before seizing the empire.

timeline.title: Cover-Up and Inheritance
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: Niro coerces Elena into telling police a home-invasion story, transfers ownership of Hart Industries, and inherits everything at sixteen.

timeline.title: Police Interview
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: Elena repeats the home-invasion lie to detectives while Niro watches through the glass with his demonic smile.

timeline.title: Hiring of Mireille Vale
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: At nineteen, Niro hires Mireille as his secretary after she declares her obsessive devotion to his ego and elegance.

timeline.title: First Boardroom Kill
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: Niro exposes Director Cho's crimes and has Mireille break his wrist and threaten him, forcing Cho's retirement and securing the board.

timeline.title: Empire Building and Boredom
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: From nineteen to twenty-seven, Niro expands Hart Industries, kills when necessary, and grows bored as a quintillionaire.

timeline.title: Rumor of the Tokyo Vessel
timeline.novel: Override Zone: The 'Hart' that shall beat
timeline.summary: At twenty-seven, Niro hears of a boy in Tokyo bonded to an ancient maiden and leaking Corruption Mana, sparking his interest.

timeline.title: Blood Tournament Opening
timeline.summary: The Crimson Veil Arena opens with thousands of spectators; the 12 True Weavers, Niro Hart, and representatives of the Nine Realms are introduced before the first bouts.

timeline.title: Naobito's Meteor Arrival
timeline.summary: Naobito and Yurei shatter their viewing window and descend from deep space as a blazing violet meteor, cracking the arena floor and announcing the Symbiote-Host bracket.

timeline.title: Hana Yagami's Arrival
timeline.summary: The Mistress of Threads steps into the pit in cyan mana, freezing the arena, and triggers a memory flashback of Naobito's infancy as the first Key.

timeline.title: Naobito vs Lord Varak
timeline.summary: Lord Varak shatters Hana's gate to challenge Naobito, but is systematically dismantled and bound in violet bandages within seconds.

timeline.title: Isolde Aster's Challenge
timeline.summary: The revived Sword Saint of Lightning fights Naobito in a cyan-violet storm dome, delivers Hana's message that the tournament is a filter and the Keys are hidden among the fighters, and whispers 'Pass' upon defeat.

timeline.title: Hollow Shell Split & Mindscape Bridging
timeline.summary: Yurei is pulled into Naobito's mindscape (a rainy apartment) to bridge broken soul-nodes while Naobito fights Isolde solo, then returns with administrative access and optimized power.

timeline.title: Sylvara's Awakening
timeline.summary: Yurei's voice tells Sylvara to scream; her Echo ability awakens in an apocalyptic sonic blast that staggers the Goliath.

timeline.title: Fused Range Crest vs Goliath
timeline.summary: Naobito and Sylvara create a fused Range Crest and launch the Goliath several light-years into deep space.

timeline.title: Mindscape Bonding
timeline.summary: Naobito pulls Sylvara into his mindscape, where she feels like family; they agree to finish the fight together.

timeline.title: Kenshi's Arrival
timeline.summary: Kenshi Kashimo travels from Neo-Haven via smuggler Gate, breaks into the under-arena corridor, and reunites with Naobito.

timeline.title: Asha Nkosi's Challenge
timeline.summary: Asha invokes her authority as a True Weaver to turn her match into a 2v1 against Naobito/Yurei and Kenshi, demanding a full-strength fight.

timeline.title: Hollow Shell vs Asha
timeline.summary: Naobito uses K'tai to house Yurei in a reconstructed body, fighting Asha with scythe, wings, and Kenshi's kinetic support, then rewriting Yurei's code to phase through Apex Mantle.

timeline.title: Arena Destruction
timeline.summary: The final three-way clash shatters the Crimson Veil Arena's spatial barriers, vaporizing spectator rows and exposing the fight to the open sky.

timeline.title: Draw Declaration & Class-S Designation
timeline.summary: Selene declares the match a draw and designates Naobito a Class-S Reality Anomaly, sealing the footage.

timeline.title: Finals Announcement
timeline.summary: Hana declares Naobito already qualified for the finals and places him directly into the Weavers' VIP box, where Lucien shows unprecedented warmth.

timeline.title: Kiritaka's Visit
timeline.summary: Naobito's immortal father appears in deep space, confirms his knowledge of the Key design, expresses pride, and warns that the remaining Keys are waking.

timeline.title: Epilogues
timeline.summary: Asha keeps her scars in the Primal Expanse; Selene designates Naobito Class-S and Viktor forges reality-binding chains while Thorn drafts a chimera; Lucien moves three pieces onto a Neo-Haven square.

timeline.title: Blood Tournament Aftermath Broadcast
timeline.summary: VeilNet Live in Lusthara interviews Kenshi and Naobito about the arena's collapse and the anomalous rewrite event while millions watch.

timeline.title: Leon Cross's Bar Confrontation and White Lockdown
timeline.summary: An Ivory Board Knight demands Leon's bar and power grid after an unregistered Key signature; Leon's collar flares; Iris Vane tears a blood rift and extracts Leon and Proxy.
