timeline.title: Extraction to Neo Haven and Iris's Deal
timeline.summary: Iris brings Leon and Proxy to Neo Haven and offers protection and collar removal in exchange for breaking Board assets.

timeline.title: Reno's Fold and Shadow-War Revelation
timeline.summary: Reno folds the group into a warehouse, reveals the Weavers are building a rebellion against the High Queen, and removes Leon's collar, awakening the Key of Focus.

timeline.title: Niro's Penthouse and Neutral-Ground Arrangement
timeline.summary: The group arrives at Niro's penthouse; Niro offers shelter and a front-row seat to Board damage while Mireille distrusts Leon.

timeline.title: Kenshi's Arrival and Sparring
timeline.summary: Kenshi arrives at the penthouse, spars with Leon in the sublevel, and the group plans a public strike on a Board suppression tower.

timeline.title: Leon's Sublevel Training and Compression Lesson
timeline.summary: Leon fires the Key of Focus in the warded sublevel; feeling it is only a laser, he receives Niro's mana-compression lesson and demonstration of 5 mega seams.

timeline.title: Naobito's Sealed Meeting with Six Weavers
timeline.summary: Naobito asks Amara, Mei Ling, Isabella, Omar, Freya, and Soren to help extract Nemimoth from the Ivory Dome; they agree to a preliminary assessment.

timeline.title: Yurei's Warning in the Mindscape
timeline.summary: Yurei confronts Naobito about moving too fast and risking both of them for Nemimoth; he embraces her and reaffirms he is not replacing her.

timeline.title: Shadow-Breach of the Ivory Dome
timeline.summary: Soren pulls Naobito into Nemimoth's chamber; Nemimoth greets him as brother; the High Queen enters expecting him; Naobito orders Soren to take Nemimoth and stays behind.

timeline.title: Elite District Overlook Watch
timeline.summary: Soren and Nemimoth watch the damaged Ivory Dome from the elite district terrace; Nemimoth vows not to return if Naobito is broken.

timeline.title: Naobito vs High Queen
timeline.summary: Naobito fights the High Queen while restraining himself; she wounds him; Yurei surfaces with six eyes and threatens her; the six Weavers assault the Dome; Lucien stops time.

timeline.title: High Queen's Prophecy
timeline.summary: The High Queen tells Naobito the Keys will become sentient weapons and 'god's funniest jokes'; Lucien drags all into the Override Zone to discuss it.

timeline.title: Kenshi's Warning Call
timeline.summary: In Niro's sublevel, Kenshi receives a call that Naobito is locked in the Ivory Dome with the High Queen; the group reacts and prepares.

timeline.title: Leon's Public Destruction of Suppression Tower
timeline.summary: Leon fires a compressed cobalt beam through the Board suppression tower; Kenshi handles Enforcers; Proxy hijacks feeds; the King provides the regulator backdoor; the pulse dies and collars fail safe; Leon finishes the tower.

timeline.title: Nemimoth's Extraction to the Loom Sanctum
timeline.summary: Nemimoth appears in the Loom Sanctum where Hana tells her she is not yet an awakened Key; the Weavers argue over Lucien's overreach.

timeline.title: Nemimoth's Safehouse and Sister Recognition
timeline.summary: Reno, Saya, and Sylvara receive Nemimoth in Elara's temporary domicile; Nemimoth senses Sylvara's half-awakened Key of Echoes and calls her sister.

timeline.title: Timeline Notice
timeline.summary: The account opens by stating it sits outside primary Override Zone continuity; certain referenced events are deliberately left unexplained and not every detail is authoritative.

timeline.title: Overheard Names in the Linen Room
timeline.summary: Kitsuke overhears two maids whispering about Naobito Yagami, the Dome, the Queen, the Keys, and the Mistress, seeding the compound's hidden history.

timeline.title: Telepathy Confrontation
timeline.summary: Haruto tells Kitsuke his thoughts are loud, admits he hears and sorts minds, and promises not to report private thoughts; Kitsuke's fear becomes wary trust.

timeline.title: Family Dinner Disclosure
timeline.summary: Kitsuke tells his family about Haruto's telepathy; Ryo, Aya, Mei, and Hanae react with anger, worry, and practical protection.

timeline.title: Crimson Market Errand
timeline.summary: Haruto takes Kitsuke to Neo-Haven's Crimson Market by obsidian coin, commands a lure to stop, and collects a cleaned stabilizer lattice from Sae in a mute workshop.

timeline.title: Public Cryokinesis Awakening
timeline.summary: During demonstration season, Kitsuke's palm on the test crystal produces frost and ice instead of neutralization, shocking the clan; Haruto shields him from gossip.

timeline.title: Saito's Assessment
timeline.summary: Elder Saito measures Kitsuke's palm and names the power true-form Cryokinesis, writes limits, and warns that the compound's pride may be harder to train than the ice.

timeline.title: Kei Kashimo Arrives
timeline.summary: Kei meets Kitsuke on the outer path, demonstrates speed, gives advice to let ice run ahead, and flirts with the nickname snowflake.

timeline.title: Kei's Unauthorized Entry
timeline.summary: Kei enters the compound through rear stones without escort; Haruto grants temporary visitor status under Mother's conditions.

timeline.title: Lattice Seating at West Boundary
timeline.summary: Haruto seats the stabilizer lattice into the west boundary stones; the hum steadies the line and Kitsuke learns not to answer the surge with a wall.

timeline.title: Storehouse Roof Trespass
timeline.summary: Aya, Mei, and Kitsuke climb the north storehouse roof; Haruto overrides a courier's alarm and lets the children be children.

timeline.title: Toma Dominance Bout
timeline.summary: Kitsuke sends ice ahead and puts the older neutralization elite Toma on one knee in the center square, earning respect.

timeline.title: Jin's Sealed Exchange
timeline.summary: Gimmickless Jin Kurogane challenges and defeats Kitsuke in pure hand-to-hand, teaching him that fights can be fun and that not all allies light up.

timeline.title: First Ice Training
timeline.summary: Kei trains Kitsuke at the west edge to throw frost lines with intention; he converts a panic surge into a controlled sheet.

timeline.title: Dream of the Ice Giant
timeline.summary: Kitsuke dreams of a jointed ice giant checked by a winged dark figure and a blue-plasma grinner, then trains before dawn to turn the fear into aimed cuts.

timeline.title: Snow Flower for Mei
timeline.summary: After the assessment, Kitsuke makes a small ice flower on the engawa; Mei licks it and laughs, and the family holds together.

timeline.title: Suspicious Elder's Offer
timeline.summary: Near the east records annex, a kindly elder warns Kitsuke that some clan attention is inventory and offers a 'better place,' sounding like a different cage.

timeline.title: Abduction of Kitsuke
timeline.summary: An unknown matte-black operative defeats Kei, sedates Kitsuke, and carries him out; Haruto arrives too late. Kitsuke is held for a master who collects useful winters.
